drift.statement: whether a dynamically constructed import path stays stdlib-only cannot be determined by static analysis

findings.expected: ADR-0001 stdlib-only is observable in the import graph
findings.observed: a dynamic import path defeats static resolution
findings.impact: compliance cannot be asserted or refuted statically
findings.failure_scenario: an ASSURE run that guessed COMPLIANT here would validate the implementation against itself
findings.recommendation_direction: require a runtime import audit, or forbid dynamic import construction by ADR

non_coverage.reason: static analysis cannot resolve dynamic import paths -- INDETERMINATE, not COMPLIANT
